host_base.description: Hostname for S3 API requests. See --host.

host_bucket.description: DNS-style bucket+hostname:port template for accessing a bucket. See --host-bucket.

default_region.description: Region to create bucket in. See --region.

use_https.description: Use HTTPS connection when communicating with S3. See --ssl.

enable_encryption.description: Encrypt files before uploading to S3. See --encrypt.

enable_server_side_encryption.description: Specifies that server-side encryption will be used when putting objects. See --server-side-encryption.

storage_class.description: Store object with specified CLASS (STANDARD, STANDARD_IA, ONEZONE_IA, INTELLIGENT_TIERING, GLACIER or DEEP_ARCHIVE). See --storage-class.

default_mime_type.description: Default MIME-type for stored objects. See --default-mime-type.

guess_mime_type.description: Guess MIME-type of files by their extension or mime magic. See --guess-mime-type.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of times to retry a failed request before giving up. See --max-retries.

multipart_chunk_size_mb.description: Size of each chunk of a multipart upload in Mega-Bytes. See --multipart-chunk-size-mb.

cf_access_key_id.description: AWS Access Key ID used for CloudFront operations. If empty, defaults to access_key.

cf_secret_access_key.description: AWS Secret Access Key used for CloudFront operations. If empty, defaults to secret_key.

exclude_patterns.description: Filenames and paths matching GLOB will be excluded from sync. See --exclude. List of strings.

include_patterns.description: Filenames and paths matching GLOB will be included even if previously excluded. See --include. List of strings.

ssl_client_cert_file.description: Path to client own SSL certificate CRT_FILE. See --ssl-cert.

ssl_client_key_file.description: Path to client own SSL certificate private key KEY_FILE. See --ssl-key.

ca_certs_file.description: Path to SSL CA certificate FILE. See --ca-certs.
